label: rem:canonical-action-obstruction
title: Scalar-ambiguity obstruction of the canonical action
html:
Remark. Scalar-ambiguity obstruction of the canonical action

The observability axiom \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathbf{C}}(\mathbf{1}, \mathrm{Ad}(A)) = 0 ensures that the trace \mathrm{tr} \colon \mathrm{End}(A) \to R is faithful. No endomorphism is invisible to integration. Relaxing this condition allows hidden symmetries and introduces a nontrivial kernel in the trace. The obstruction to recovering a well-defined action is classified by the cohomology class \kappa \in H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathcal{B}) that obstructs lifting in the quantum-lifting sense.
